full_text_en:
Tongling Shizishan District People's Procuratorate v. Zha Congyu and Huang Baogen — illegal trading of explosives

【Ruling Summary】

The defendants' act of illegally trading explosives has constituted the crime of illegally trading explosive materials. However, given that they indeed illegally traded explosives out of livelihood needs, without causing serious social harm, and have shown genuine repentance through education, they may be sentenced to a punishment below the statutory punishment.

Criminal Ruling of the Supreme People's Court

(2004) Xing Fu Zi No. 216

Defendant Zha Congyu, male, born September 16, 1957, Han ethnicity, from Tongling County, Anhui Province, with primary school education, blaster at the stone factory of Chaitang Village, Xihu Town, Shizishan District, Tongling, residing at Nonglin Administrative Village, Xihu Town, Shizishan District, Tongling. Arrested on November 5, 2003. Currently in custody.

Defendant Huang Baogen (also known as Huang Baogen), male, born January 12, 1966, Han ethnicity, from Tongling County, Anhui Province, with primary school education, farmer, residing at Nonglin Administrative Village, Xihu Town, Shizishan District, Tongling. Arrested on November 5, 2003. Currently in custody.

The Shizishan District People's Court of Tongling, Anhui Province, having tried the case of Tongling Shizishan District People's Procuratorate charging defendants Zha Congyu and Huang Baogen with the crime of illegally trading explosive materials, rendered a criminal judgment on March 3, 2004 under (2004) Shi Xing Chu Zi No. 8, finding defendants Zha Congyu and Huang Baogen guilty of the crime of illegally trading explosive materials and sentencing each to ten years' imprisonment with deprivation of political rights for one year. After the judgment was pronounced, Zha Congyu and Huang Baogen both appealed. The Tongling Intermediate People's Court rendered a criminal judgment on May 31, 2004 under (2004) Tong Zhong Xing Zhong Zi No. 17, finding defendants Zha Congyu and Huang Baogen guilty of the crime of illegally trading explosive materials, and sentencing Zha Congyu to three years' imprisonment below the statutory punishment, and sentencing Huang Baogen to three years' imprisonment with a three-year suspension of sentence below the statutory punishment. The Anhui High People's Court, upon review, approved and reported the case to this Court for approval in accordance with the law. This Court formed a collegial panel in accordance with the law to review the case. The review is now concluded.

Upon review, the following facts have been confirmed: On October 23, 2003, defendant Huang Baogen, in order to repair the house of his disabled brother, asked defendant Zha Congyu to help him purchase explosives for use in blasting stones in the mountains, and Zha Congyu agreed to help. Thereafter, taking advantage of his position as a blaster at the stone factory, Zha Congyu took home 12 kilograms of rock-type powdery emulsion explosives from the explosives he had collected. On the evening of October 27, 2003, Huang Baogen went to Zha Congyu's home to collect the explosives and paid Zha Congyu RMB 100. While carrying the explosives on his way home, Huang Baogen was apprehended by public security authorities.

The above facts are confirmed by the seized explosives and appraisal conclusions, the explosives distribution list, and witness testimony. Defendants Zha Congyu and Huang Baogen also confessed, which is sufficient to establish the facts.

Opinion of the Court: The acts of defendants Zha Congyu and Huang Baogen in illegally trading explosives have constituted the crime of illegally trading explosive materials. Illegally trading explosive materials is a serious offense and should be punished according to law. Given that Zha Congyu and Huang Baogen indeed illegally traded explosives out of livelihood needs, without causing serious social harm, and have shown genuine repentance through education, the two defendants may be sentenced to a punishment below the statutory punishment. The facts found in the judgments of first and second instance are clear, the evidence is reliable and sufficient, and the conviction is accurate. The trial procedures were lawful. The sentence in the second instance judgment is appropriate. In accordance with Article 63, Paragraph 2 of the Criminal Law of the PRC and Article 270 of the Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues Concerning the Implementation of the Criminal Procedure Law of the PRC, it is ruled as follows:

Approval of the criminal judgment of the Tongling Intermediate People's Court, Anhui Province, under (2004) Tong Zhong Xing Zhong Zi No. 17, which sentenced defendant Zha Congyu to three years' imprisonment for the crime of illegally trading explosive materials; sentenced defendant Huang Baogen to three years' imprisonment with a three-year suspension of sentence for the crime of illegally trading explosive materials; and ordered the illegal proceeds of RMB 100 to be recovered.

This ruling shall become legally effective upon service.

Presiding Judge: Ren Xiancheng

Judge: Wang Guixiao

Acting Judge: Dong Bei

Clerk: Liu Shiqian

November 5, 2004

[Introduction of the Presiding Judge]

Senior Judge Ren Xiancheng: Born in 1954, with a bachelor's degree in law, served as a judge of the Supreme People's Court since 2000.
